g.text: A rule is you telling the computer exactly what to

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: do. Rules break when the world has too many

g.text: A model is a learned function

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Trained once on examples with answers, then used on

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: new cases where the answer is unknown.

text.style: font-weight: 500; font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1f2430
font-weight: 700; font-size: 6.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1f2430

font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430
font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: Try settings, count mistakes, keep the setting that

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: makes the fewest. That is learning, in miniature.

text.style: font-size: 5.6px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: middle; fill: #8a919c
font-weight: 700; font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #1f2430
font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: With few attacks, the best-scoring rule flags almost

text.style: font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4'; fill: #4b5563
font-size: 6.9px; font-family: 'Source Serif 4'; fill: #4b5563

g.text: nothing at all. We asked the wrong question.

g.text: The same score can be an attack or not. A good model
